discovery.title: Discovery call
discovery.short: We learn about your idea, goals and constraints. No commitment.

design.title: UX/UI design
design.short: Structure, prototypes and visuals that we agree with you before writing code.

development.title: Development
development.short: We build the site or system in short iterations you can follow.

qa.title: QA & automated testing
qa.short: Playwright tests, performance and accessibility checks before launch.
qa.details: Quality is part of development, not a last step: we check automatically and manually before anything reaches your visitors.
gets: Automated Playwright tests for key journeys

launch.title: Launch & hosting
launch.short: We publish using a checklist and set up domain, hosting and monitoring.
launch.details: We publish using a checklist and make sure everything works in the real environment.

support.title: Maintenance & support
support.short: Updates, fixes and growth — long after the project is live.
support.details: After launch we stay with you: we maintain, fix and grow the project.

FreeStart.title: We start without risk for you
FreeStart.intro: First we get to know you and show you a real result. We talk about price only once you can see the direction.

consult.title: Free consultation
consult.text: A conversation about your idea, goals and budget. No commitment.

preview.title: Skeleton & design preview
preview.text: If we agree, we build the site structure and show the design direction — for free.

decide.title: Decision & quote
decide.text: You see a real result and get a price based on complexity. Then you decide whether we continue.

conditions.title: How the free start works

scope.title: Limited scope and time
scope.text: The skeleton and preview cover the structure and key screens. Scope and timeframe are put in writing before we begin.

preview.title: Preview only
preview.text: We show the result for review. Code and files are not handed over until the project is agreed.

rights.title: Rights on payment
rights.text: Rights to the design and code transfer upon payment for the agreed project.

conditions.note: Everything is agreed in writing before we start.

Pricing.title: Clear packages, priced by complexity
Pricing.intro: The price depends on the scope and complexity of the project. That's why we start for free — and give you an exact quote once you've seen the result.

websites.title: Website packages
websites.intro: Every package includes automated tests and a pre-launch checklist.

maintenance.title: Maintenance plans
maintenance.intro: After launch we keep your site fast, secure and up to date.

custom.title: Something special?
custom.text: A web app, a booking system or an online store — tell us about it and we will propose the right solution.

About.title: Two engineers who own everything
About.intro: We're New Wave Web Intelligence — a small studio from Sofia. You work directly with the people who write the code.

designer.title: And an experienced designer on the team
designer.text: When a project needs design and visual direction, an experienced designer joins us. Development, testing, hosting and support are our own work.

quality.title: Quality built in
quality.text: Automated tests and a checklist in every project, not as an add-on.

honest.title: Honesty
honest.text: We say what's worth doing and what isn't, and clearly label what is a real project and what is a concept.

direct.title: Direct contact
direct.text: You talk to the people building your project, with no middlemen.

longterm.title: Long-term care
longterm.text: We stay with you after launch — maintenance and growth.

how.title: How we work
how.text: We start with a free consultation and a free skeleton with a design preview. We work in short iterations, test automatically and look after the project after launch.
